d: The 2030 FIFA World Cup is still four years away, but the battle over its biggest match has already begun. Spain and Morocco are both eyeing the right to host the World Cup final, with Morocco pushing its proposed 115,000-capacity Hassan II Stadium while Spain has the Santiago Bernabeu in contention. The controversy has now taken a political turn, with Spanish opposition leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo even threatening Spain's withdrawal if Morocco gets the final.
